name: un-r157-dssad
status: draft mapping, not an official schema
title: UN Regulation No 157 (ALKS), paragraph 8: Data Storage System for Automated Driving, one entry per occurrence
source: UN R157 as published in OJ L 82, 9.3.2021, paragraph 8 (https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/HTML/?uri=CELEX:42021X0389); the 01-series Amendment 1 (Jan 2022) has the same DSSAD wording. Occurrences from 8.2.1, data elements from 8.3.1 to 8.3.3. Whether the 2025-2026 supplements changed paragraph 8 has not been checked. The topic and field names are Quaill placeholders: a vehicle maker points them at its own export with --map.
notes: R157 asks for an event list, not a time series: an entry each time the automated lane keeping system is activated, deactivated, hands back to the driver, suppresses driver input, starts or ends an emergency manoeuvre, triggers the EDR, detects a collision, engages a minimum risk manoeuvre, or fails. Each entry carries the occurrence, its reason where 8.2.1 lists reasons, the date, a timestamp to the second with its timezone (accuracy 1 s), and the software version present at the time (8.3.2). It does not identify the driver; data access is left to national law (1.2, 8.1). Storage capacity, first-in-first-out overwriting, crash survivability, OBD readout and anti-tampering (8.4, 8.5) are properties of the system, not of one export, so this profile cannot check them. Pairing ACTIVATION with DEACTIVATION is this profile reading 8.2.1 as: every activation ends in a deactivation entry; that is not the regulation text. EMERGENCY_MANOEUVRE_START/END pairing is explicit in the text.

items.name: Reason for a deactivation (8.3.1 b; 8.2.1 b i-iv)
Reason for a transition demand (8.3.1 b; 8.2.1 c i-vii)
Timestamp hh:mm:ss with timezone, accuracy 1 s (8.3.1 d)
Software version present at the time of the event, R157SWIN or equivalent (8.3.2)
Order hint when several elements share one timestamp (8.3.3)
